## Goal

What user-visible or architectural capability will this deliver?

## Scope

- In scope:
- Out of scope:

## Dependencies and design references

Link actual issues and relevant docs. Distinguish proposed interfaces from existing ones.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concrete observable behavior
- [ ] Error and conflict behavior
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated

## Safety / permissions

State whether this is fixture-only, read-only live verification, or requires separate approval for HA changes/playback. Default: no live side effects.

## Verification evidence

Commands/checks actually run, environment, result, and remaining blockers. Do not substitute mock success for live verification.
